summary: Sets the global camera view mode (dword_7C74F8) and, on the enabled-with-state path, clears three render-offset fields (0x34EC/0x34F0/0x34F4) to 0. The branch taken depends on the input flag a2 and the internal state flag at this[3247] (offset 0x32BC). Used during pit stop camera transitions by PitStopReadyCheck and PitStopProgress.

operations.description: Initialize result to 0 and read the internal camera-state flag v3 from this[3247] (offset 0x32BC).
Branch on the enable flag a2 being non-zero (camera change requested); otherwise take the a2 == 0 path.
Within the enabled path, branch on the internal state flag v3: when set, clear render offsets; when clear, set the view-mode global instead.
Clear the three render-offset fields 0x34EC, 0x34F0 and 0x34F4 to 0.
On the enabled path with v3 clear, set the camera view mode global dword_7C74F8 to 2.
On the a2 == 0 (disable) path, act only when the internal state flag v3 is also clear.
Set the camera view mode global dword_7C74F8 to 0 on the disable path.

unresolved: The identity of the state flag at offset 0x32BC (camera/pit-stop condition) is unknown; the owner object is unknown.
Whether this function acts on the player camera object or the active-slot camera is unresolved.
